title: Diligent Autonomous Business AI - Advisory Disclaimer & Liability Waiver
summary: Diligent is an agentic AI advisory platform designed to assist SMB owners with inventory analysis, predictive sales intelligence, and marketing content drafts. Execution of strategic recommendations is solely at the merchant's discretion.

clauses.heading: 1. Advisory Nature of Agent Intelligence
clauses.content: All insights, pricing recommendations, capital reallocations, inventory reorder suggestions, and marketing copy generated by Diligent and its subagents are strictly algorithmic and advisory in nature. Diligent does not guarantee specific revenue gains, footfall surges, or margins.

clauses.heading: 2. Assumption of Operational and Financial Risk
clauses.content: The business owner/merchant assumes 100% legal, financial, and regulatory responsibility for any operational adjustments, price alterations, public advertisements, employee management shifts, or vendor orders made in reliance upon Diligent's swarm outputs.

clauses.heading: 3. Human-in-the-Loop Safeguards
clauses.content: Autonomous execution of e-commerce storefront modifications, automated POS price adjustments, and bulk marketing dispatch require explicit merchant authorization via the Safeguard Confirmation Gateway.

clauses.heading: 4. Enterprise Data Privacy & Telemetry
clauses.content: Business telemetry, including POS barcode logs, customer CRM profiles, and payroll metrics, are processed in strict isolation and encrypted in transit and at rest.

jurisdiction: Hyderabad, Telangana, India - Subject to the Information Technology Act, 2000 and Applicable Indian Commercial Laws.
